content: How do I change the window/level in the CT viewer?

name: search_docs

content: Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'How do I change the window/level in the CT viewer?'

To change window/level in the CT viewer: **drag the left side of the screen**.

The CT viewer uses Cornerstone3D over DICOMweb, with these mouse controls:

| Action | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| Mouse wheel | Change slice |
| Left drag | Window/level |
| Middle drag | Pan |
| Right drag | Zoom |

The initial window/level is the one stored by the scanner; CochleaHub does not set a default value [S2][S3].
